answer.justification: Only activation-level data are available. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.086, at the low end of the fine-tuned range (0.086-0.092) and below the quantized (0.096-0.105) and system-prompted (0.113-0.133) ranges. The mid-layer size ratio is 1.018, so the internal state grows, which matches fine-tuned (1.017-1.023). Quantized and system-prompted models both shrink it. Direction consistency is 0.625 (fine-tuned 0.618-0.705), onset layer is 3 (fine-tuned 3-14), and layer 16 and layer 32 values (0.162, 0.297) and cosine 0.952 all fall in the fine-tuned ranges. The layer-2 spike of 1.2 is small, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64). Effective rank of 3.62 is slightly above the fine-tuned range (2.89-3.58) but well below quantized (3.99-4.05). Quantized is also ruled out by the growing size ratio and the layer-8 to layer-24 pattern, which is not flat at 0.19-0.21.
